name: dionysus-queue
author: Neil Fritz
about: Publishes all queue events to a RabbbitMQ exchange.
queueEvents: NZB_DOWNLOADED, NZB_ADDED, NZB_PAUSED, NZB_RESUMED, NZB_DELETED, NZB_COMPLETED, NZB_FAILED
requirements: This script requires Python 3.10 or later and the pika (https://github.com/pika/pika) library.
description: This script proxies all QUEUE events to a RabbitMQ exchange.

options.name: RABBITMQ_HOST
description: The AMQP host to publish messages to

options.name: RABBITMQ_PORT
description: The AMQP server port to connect to

options.name: RABBITMQ_VHOST
description: The virtual host to publish messages to

options.name: RABBITMQ_USERNAME
description: The username to sue when connecting to to the AMQP host

options.name: RABBITMQ_PASSWORD
description: The password to sue when connecting to to the AMQP host
